items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Crude oil prices fell more than 7% after reports suggested the U.S. and Iran are exploring diplomatic solutions to Middle East tensions. I bonds currently offer a 5.51% interest rate, making them attractive for investors. Just before the midterms, traders on Kalshi predict Democrats have a 74% chance to control the Senate. Two startups working on water solutions for data centers are merging in a $16 million deal.
